description.p: Nibform is a 3D CAD modeler for Linux tablets and convertibles, made to be used with a pen. Sketch with constraints and dimensions, pull faces into solids, round and chamfer edges, and change any step later from the history.

Nibform to modeler 3D CAD dla tabletów i laptopów 2 w 1 z Linuksem, stworzony do pracy rysikiem. Szkicuj z więzami i wymiarami, wyciągaj ściany w bryły, zaokrąglaj i fazuj krawędzie, a każdy krok zmieniaj później z historii.

ul.li: Sketches with constraints and live dimensions
Extrude, fillet, chamfer, shell and boolean operations
Pen, touch and palm rejection; a tablet mode with large controls

description.p: Sheet metal: base and edge flanges, hems, tabs, bend and corner reliefs, shelled parts converted, and the flat pattern kept up to date, as DXF and as a drawing view. Python scripting: an API to the project, generated features that stay editable, a console, macros, plugins and headless runs. A sketch on a face now follows the face.

Pen-first sketching, a larger sketch toolkit, revolve / sweep / loft and other solid features, transforms and measuring, STEP / IGES / STL import, technical drawings, background rebuilds, parameters and configurations, threads and text, and assemblies with joints, interference checks, exploded views and a parts list. Builds for Linux (AppImage, Flatpak), Windows and macOS.
Autosave and crash recovery, recent files, an About dialog, desktop integration and packages.
